Thomas D. Westergaard is a Danish designer and founder of Ceremoni Studio, where he transforms the traditional candle into a kinetic sculpture. Instead of treating wax as a static object, he engineers candles that bend, twist, and weave together as they burn. Every prototype is tested through long time-lapse recordings to study the flame, the melting wax, and the structure, refining each design until movement and combustion become one. His work sits somewhere between industrial design, engineering, and performance. #art #artist #avantgarde #candles #timelapse

You have to choose one: Vaporeon, Jolteon, or Flareon? That choice is basically the whole idea behind this colored sand art piece. Eevee sits in the center while the original three Eeveelutions surround it, so you can see all three possible Gen 1 outcomes at the same time. What makes this group especially fun visually is that they barely feel like simple recolors of one another. Jolteon becomes sharp, angular, and electric yellow. Vaporeon completely changes direction with blue aquatic features, fins, and a long tail. Flareon keeps more of Eevee’s fluffy shape but turns it into a warm orange-and-cream Fire-type design. Then Eevee stays right in the middle as the little neutral starting point connecting all three. Every colored section is made with sand, so the yellows, blues, oranges, creams, browns, and smaller details all have that soft granular texture instead of a flat painted finish. For anyone into Eevee, Eeveelutions, Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Pokémon evolution art, Gen 1 Pokémon nostalgia, colored sand art, satisfying art processes, fan art, or ASMR-style craft videos, this one combines all of those in a single piece. satisfying sand art ASMR

This is the clock that becomes digital from analog a stunning piece of kinetic art and engineering. Dozens of individual analog clocks are arranged in a grid on a large wall panel. Each clock has two independently controlled hands. When the time changes, every hand rotates in perfect coordination so that groups of clocks form the shapes of digital numbers. Six clocks typically work together to create one digit. Across the full wall they display hours and minutes in clear digital form, then smoothly transition to the next minute with a mesmerizing dance of moving hands. #clock #art  #worldrecord

Kinetic sand is a great way to provide sensory input while still working on a multitude of skills.  I love to use cookie cutters in the sand to work on bilateral skills, pressure and and force regulation.  Cutting with sand is a great introduction to snipping and provides additional sensory feedback. Kids who are struggling with writing tend to be more willing to practice writing on different surfaces. Try sand and use a paint brush for smooth lines.  #occupationaltherapy #ot #sensoryactivities #finemotorskills #sensory #schoolbasedot

videos.caption: Kinetic Art Explained: Art History & The Science of Movement  | Seed Gallery Kinetic Art is a dynamic genre in Art History defined by works that contain movement perceivable by the viewer or employ motion to achieve their intent. Deriving from the Greek word kinesis, this term applies to any medium, from painting to sculpture, where movement is an integral part of the aesthetic. We explore how Kinetic Art challenges the traditional stasis of the art object. We trace its evolution from canvas paintings that create multidimensional movement to modern solar-powered installations and sculptures that use wind and water. By making motion the primary focus, Kinetic Art invites a deeper interaction between the work and the observer. At Seed Gallery, the Art History and Economics Glossary explores the principles of visual structure and theory that shape artistic expression across time. 👉 Subscribe for ongoing insights into art history, materials, and visual culture.   Learn more at: seedgallerynewyork.com   #KineticArt #ArtHistory #Kinesis #VisualCulture #ArtEducation #FineArt #SeedGallery #ArtTheory #Sculpture #ModernArt
